limits.value: storage above the namespace purchased amount is billed; the registry is excluded from the 10 GiB repository quota

limits_note: the 10 GiB figure that circulates is the repository quota and not the registry quota; the two are different limits and the comparison literature conflates them
confidence_note: the storage-quota doc was read and states the exclusion.

notes: An exclusion is not an allowance. The doc says the registry does not count against 10 GiB; it does not say the registry is free, and no separate free figure is published.
